highLevelGoal: Reopen Orca-Strator V1 as NOT YET QUALIFIED and perform a deep runtime-integration hardening campaign until the real production path works end-to-end: watcher->loop->executor->result->loop->Sol wake wired in production, correct Windows/WSL/Git/browser/recovery/control semantics, and a real qualification tier that proves the pipeline with real Git, real child-process executors, and durable result manifests.

checkpoint.summary: Final hardening pass through the second deep-review 18 items. Fix #1: Sol-boundary drain completion — DRAINING now honors valid next dispatch as boundary (Stop->STOPPED, Ceiling->CEILING_REACHED without launching executor, dispatch consumed). Fix #2: dispatch correlation — repositoryId/runId/iteration/status validated, stale/wrong-run dispatch rejected observably, no Sol-operation close for stale. Fix #3/#4: drainReason persisted (USER_STOP/WALL_CLOCK_CEILING/ITERATION_CEILING) + wall-clock rehydration (startedAt+maxRuntime, expired deadline reconstructs DRAINING without killing actor, BrowserManager SOL rehydrated via SolWakeStore). Fix #5: BrowserManager.rehydrateFromStore resumes SOL_REVIEWING waiting/retry/stall without duplicate wakes. Fix #6: pause is executor-only (SOL_REVIEWING/SOL_PENDING yields 400). Fix #7-9: busy is bounded backpressure (3 retries, BUSY_MAX_RETRIES) not instant SOL_STALLED; auth/CAPTCHA -> ATTENTION_REQUIRED; removed full-page body scraping (scoped dialogs/banners only). Fix #11: RunStore no longer swallows DB errors (surfaced). Fix #12: GitClient.getRemoteHeadSha environment-aware (WSL routes through wsl.exe). Fix #14: awaitSpawn 10ms fallback removed; FakeExecutor now emits spawn. Fix #15: preflight now inspects dirty/localHead/remoteHead/relation (up-to-date/ahead/behind/diverged), never resets dirty, emits evidence, passes ORCA_PREFLIGHT_EVIDENCE to executor. Fix #16: Sol-wake/drain race — submitSolWakeForRun re-checks DRAINING before writing SOL_REVIEWING and does not resurrect terminal runs. Provisioning: browser:install + fixed playwright:status scripts. Harness: Stop now naturally drains (no forced kill), kill isolation restored, ceiling no-kill. New focused tests: loop-drain-correlation (stop/ceiling/stale/future/race) and run-store-db-failure.
